beats.tagline: The compounding data engine for physical AI
say: This is Axis Robotics.
Language models inherited the internet. Robots have no corpus of physical experience, so it is building one.

beats.head:
From simulation
to reality
say: This week, it showed how a skill learned in simulation gets to the real world.
First, an expert is trained in simulation, with reinforcement learning.
Then that expert is distilled into a vision policy: one that works from what a camera sees.
And the rooms keep changing, in colour and in light. That's visual randomization.
Then it's deployed on a real robot.

beats.head: Placed at random
say: Here's their demo: the simulation above, the real arm below.
The objects are placed at random, anywhere across the space. No fixed positions needed.
In the company's words: simulation provides scalable expertise, and vision distillation brings it to reality.

beats.head: The Challenger program
say: The data comes from contributors, who run robot tasks right in a browser.
The hardest tasks go to the Challenger program, worth two to three times the points of a standard task.
On Monday, the company opened new Challenger spots.
Badges are given automatically, on the quality of your data and what's needed. No application.
